name: Hotpot Loop: Food Sort
summary:
Sort, Flip & Serve Your Way to Hot Pot Glory
Hotpot Loop: Food Games starts the fire in your kitchen. Step into a sizzling puzzle games where cooking, timing, and food sort collide. Every move matter as you tap, flip, and match dishes to feed the hungry Hot pot. Feel the sort thrill as the conveyor fills with juicy shrimp, smoky sausage, and fresh seafood racing toward their boiling destination.
